data.name: MissionExplanation
data.value: It will be used to create more appropriate recommended habits for you. A mission is a life goal that keeps you motivated and helps you make the best choices in a variety of situations. For example, a mission might be to become the best and most moral entrepreneur in the world.

data.name: MainSloganExplanation
data.value: The main slogan will be used to form better recommended habits. It helps you determine how to act when you don't want to do something or when you are faced with a challenge or temptation. For example, only Jesus.

data.name: QuestionExplanation
data.value: The question helps you to understand whether you have followed the habit on a particular day. For example, "Did I do my best to exercise today, at least 15 minutes?"

data.name: WithoutExceptionsHabitTypeShortDescription
data.value: This is a habit type that a person adheres to strictly and never makes exceptions, even in emergency situations. For example, refusal to drink alcohol or tobacco, regardless of the circumstances.

data.name: IntegrallyWiseHabitTypeShortDescription
data.value: This is a habit type that a person follows most of the time, but may make exceptions in special situations. For example, it may be the habit of telling the truth but being able to keep silent or deceive when it could cause serious harm to others.

data.name: ReasonToFollowExplanation
data.value: Understanding why it is important to follow your habits helps you better determine how to act and improves your motivation to do something. It makes our actions consistent and reflects our character.

data.name: MessageInDeleteHabitConfirm
data.value: The habit will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.

data.name: MessageInDeleteAccountConfirm
data.value: The account will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.
